summary.text: Armen Kurdian is a retired U.S. Navy captain with more than 25 years of service running as the Republican candidate for CA-49. He has not previously held elected office. In his Ballotpedia survey he describes his service as leading large civilian, military and union organizations, and says he has volunteered in local nonprofits and local government.

paragraphs.text: Attended Wichita East High School and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Kansas in 1993.
Served in the U.S. Navy from 1993 to 2018 and retired as a captain; says he led large organizations of hundreds of people, including civil, military and union workforces.
Earned a graduate degree from the Naval Postgraduate School in 2003 and another from Cornell University in 2014.
Lists engineering manager as his career experience.
Says that after retiring he continued community service in local nonprofits and local government, and that he has volunteered thousands of hours without payment.
Advanced from the June 2, 2026 top-two primary with 26.1% of the vote, behind Levin (55.9%).
